verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a stablecoin-to-fiat off-ramp: a redeem orchestration converts stablecoins to USD and withdraws to a bank in one call, and the Fiat Transfers API supports Fedwire, SWIFT and CUBIX withdrawals to registered fiat accounts. However, everything evidenced is USD-only and aimed at the client's own bank account, not recipients receiving local currency across many markets. missing for 10: non-USD local-currency payouts, a published list of supported currencies/countries, recipient-facing (third-party) payout flows, local bank rails beyond wire/CUBIX, independent corroboration.
